name: project-tracker
description: Per-project task list in a docked side pane, persisted in <repo>/.claude/tasks.md across sessions

autoOpen.title: Open the Tasks pane at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the Tasks pane when a session starts (it docks beside the transcript in the fullscreen layout on a wide enough terminal).

statusLine.title: Show task count in the status line
statusLine.description: Show the open-task count and the current in-progress task in the status line.

injectContext.title: Tell Claude about open tasks
injectContext.description: Add the project's open tasks to Claude's system prompt each turn.

registerProject.title: List this project in the project index
registerProject.description: Record projects that have a task file in ~/.claude/project-tracker/projects.json, so chats can find them by name.

taskFile.title: Task file
taskFile.description: Path of the task file, relative to the project root.
